description: Dependency updates for Hearth (BUILD-PLAN C0.1, TECH-SPEC). Nothing merges automatically: every update goes through CI, CodeRabbit and Qodo like any PR (CLAUDE.md, Git). npmrc's min-release-age makes the weekly lock file refresh keep the same 7-day rule as minimumReleaseAge.

customManagers.description: The gitleaks version that ci.yml's secrets job installs through the Go module proxy.

packageRules.description: Node stays on 24 LTS (T2, D37): moving to the next LTS is a decision, not an update.
Postgres stays on 17 (T3). The pg17 tag already follows the newest pgvector build for 17.
Vite is pinned in the root and in demo/ so they share one copy; update both together.
